## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`fix:`, `feature:`, `enhancement:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`), in English
- [ ] The checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Quartel-Enterprise/blitz-split-site/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#making-a-change) pass
- [ ] Every new string is translated in every language of the site
- [ ] A visual change is checked in `design/board.html`, at every size, in light and dark
- [ ] Legal text is edited in `public/legal/*.md` and release notes in `release-notes/`, then rebuilt
- [ ] A new analytics event has its row in `docs/analytics.md`
- [ ] The docs under `docs/` are updated, if the behavior changed
